description: This file defines an abstract base class for notification preset generators in an Android wearable notifications project. It includes a constructor and an abstract method for building notifications, with relevant comments and license information.

classes.name: NotificationPreset
classes.description: An abstract class representing a notification preset generator, with a method to build a notification based on the preset.

methods.name: NotificationPreset
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the preset with a resource ID for its name.

methods.name: buildNotification
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to create and return a Notification object, given a Context.
